verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of FireHydrant's core product. Everything shown describes a hosted SaaS tenant with API access (api.firehydrant.io), and the open-source MCP server is a client wrapper, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
